kebab_example: aliyun ehpc edit-job-template --template-id ehpc-job-tmpl-6RxO5y0000 --command-line ./LammpsTest/lammps.pbs --name jobTemapleteName --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EditJobTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the job template.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87248.html operation to obtain the job template ID
parameters.help_zh:
作业模板ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87248.html获取待修改的模板ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The command that is used to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业命令
parameters.name: command_line

parameters.help_en:
The name of the job template.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87248.html operation to obtain the job template name
parameters.help_zh:
作业模板名称。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87248.html获取待修改的模板名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the user that runs the job.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html operation to query the users of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业的用户名。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188572.html获取用户名
parameters.name: runas_user

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A large value indicates a high priority.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
执行作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

默认值：0
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The path that is used to run the job
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业路径
parameters.name: package_path

parameters.help_en: The output file path of stdout
parameters.help_zh: 标准输出路径
parameters.name: stdout_redirect_path

parameters.help_en: The output file path of stderr
parameters.help_zh: 错误输出路径
parameters.name: stderr_redirect_path

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:

true: The job can be rerun.
false: The job cannot be rerun
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持重新执行作业。取值范围：
true：支持
false：不支持
parameters.name: re_runable

parameters.help_en:
The job array.

Format: X-Y:Z. X is the minimum index value. Y is the maximum index value. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6
parameters.help_zh:
作业队列。 

格式X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业
parameters.name: array_request

parameters.help_en: The runtime variables passed to the job. They can be accessed by using environment variables in the executable file
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的环境变量，可以在作业执行文件中访问环境变量
parameters.name: variables

parameters.help_en: The name of the queue
parameters.help_zh: 执行作业的队列名称
parameters.name: queue

parameters.help_en:
The maximum running time of the job. Valid formats:

hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

We recommend that you use the hh:mm:ss format. If the maximum running time is 12 hours, set the value to 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh:
作业最大运行时间，支持三种格式：
hh:mm:ss
mm:ss
ss

推荐使用第一种格式。若最大运行时间为12小时，示例：12:00:00
parameters.name: clock_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of the compute nodes. Valid values: 1 to 500.

If the parameter is not specified, the Task, Thread, Mem, and Gpu parameters become invalid
parameters.help_zh:
提交作业所需计算节点数。取值范围：1~500
若该参数为空，则参数Task、Thread、Mem、Gpu不生效
parameters.name: node

parameters.help_en: The number of tasks required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 单个计算节点所需任务数。取值范围：1~1000
parameters.name: task

parameters.help_en: The number of threads required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 单个任务所需线程数。取值范围：1~1000
parameters.name: thread

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory usage required by a single compute node. Unit: GB, MB, or KB. The unit is case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 单个计算节点最大使用内存数，支持GB、MB、KB，单位不区分大小写
parameters.name: mem

parameters.help_en:
The maximum GPU usage required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 8.

The parameter takes effect only when the cluster uses PBS and a compute node is a GPU-accelerated instance
parameters.help_zh:
单个计算节点使用GPU的数量，取值范围：1~8。

仅支持使用pbs调度器的集群，且集群内计算节点含GPU时该参数生效
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.help_en: The URL of the job files that are uploaded to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
parameters.help_zh: 已上传到OSS上的作业文件链接
parameters.name: input_file_url

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. Valid values:

true: The job files are decompressed.
false: The job files are not decompressed
parameters.help_zh:
是否解压下载后的作业文件。取值范围：

true：是

false：否
parameters.name: with_unzip_cmd

parameters.help_en:
The command that is used to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. The parameter takes effect only when WithUnzipCmd is set to true. Valid values:

tar xzf: decompresses GZIP files.
tar xf: decompresses TAR files.
unzip: decompresses ZIP files
parameters.help_zh:
解压命令，当WithUnzipCmd取值为true时，该参数生效。取值范围：

tar xzf：解开gzip格式压缩包

tar xf：解开tar格式压缩包

unzip：解开zip格式压缩包
parameters.name: unzip_cmd

TemplateId.description_en: The ID of the job template
